answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 11 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 610 identities costs 610 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The mesa of the quote is the proof, the horizon of the refresh is the expiry, and the river of the burn is the penalty.
